<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/api/v1/merchant/webhooks/{id}/toggle"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Flip a registered webhook between active and inactive states
without deleting it. Useful for planned merchant-side maintenance
windows or temporarily silencing a noisy endpoint. Inactive
webhooks receive no new dispatches; deliveries already queued
before the toggle may still fire once before the state takes
effect.
